programme.desc: Grizzy's last jar of chocolate spread was pinched by the Lemmings, who are savoring it in secret. To localize the Lemmings hiding place, Grizzy trains a raccoon, whose sense of smell equals that of a truffle hound to detect the scent of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Molieres travelling spectacular comes to MoleTown, it brings with it, a rather unique guest, which soon becomes very attached to Dotty.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley finds an old Movie poster about a human hero, Manny's magic conjours up an entire world of action and adventure.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mona Lisa is hosting an extravagant fashion show and she wants Moley to be the guest of honour, but what will Moley wear for the show?

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Things take a dramatic turn when the Gardener and Moley magically switch places, leading to a very bored Moley and a very tired and frustrated Gardener.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown has a spectacular fun fair and at its heart is a huge ferris wheel created by Mishmosh, but after Manny speeds things up, Moley has to save the day.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput has escaped yet again, and yet again, Specs and Skinny are in serious trouble with the Boss. He’s so fed up with their constant failure that he hires an out-of-towner: a super cool, hi-tech Doc who has all the moves and the attitude to match.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: When Mushpot is too tired to give anyone advice, he asks Mush-Mush to answer the Mushables' requests on his behalf. But now Mush-Mush thinks he is the leader of Mushton!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: When Chep thinks he has remembered that he is younger than his two best friends, Mush-Mush and Lilit, it affects his whole confidence.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit are ecstatic: Muddler’s fear of spiders rid the forest of him! But they soon learn that even Muddler is essential to the health of the forest.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Lilit looks up to Chanterelle as an awesome role model. She would so love to be like her one day. But when she starts imitating Chanterelle it doesn’t go to plan.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and friends favourite play tree the Fun Tree - is rotten and doomed. But Mush-Mush refuses to give up on it. In a last ditch effort to save the tree, our friends adventure off to try and track down the legendary Starmush, hoping his mysterious healing powers can save it.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kai and Finn must prevent the cinema’s destruction during a fight between Pop Shock and Bubbles, caused by poor-quality popcorn.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After entering Tyke in an agility contest, Spike sets up a course for the puppy in the backyard. Soon, Spike decides the course isn't hard enough and gets Tom to help, bending Tom into pretzel-like positions for Tyke to leap over, through, or into. After all this preparation, Tyke must still make it to the competition on time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case from a mother tortoise to find out where her son Seymour is sneaking off to at night. They discover Seymour is self-training to win a championship boxing match, planning to pay off bills with the prize money so his mom can quit the car wash. When he offers Tom and Jerry a cut of the money to keep his secret, they take it and agree to train him—but it won't be easy.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger and Rick's vegetable garden is growing, and they need a way to keep out the gophers. Ginger says traps are cruel, but Tom can handle the task! However, things start getting out of hand when a lady gopher falls in love with Jerry, and the two plan a garden raid together.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie tells Tom that he won't have to sweat a visit from one of the spooks tonight. However, Tom is soon drawn to a full-length mirror that causes no shortage of trouble. As he gets pulled into the mirror, an evil reflection cat trades places with him. Tuffy and Jerry enter the mirror world too and must fight their reflection selves for survival.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Stinker, the trash-loving dog, comes by looking for help, Tom and Jerry aren't inclined to take the case until they hear it involves a missing fortune. So, they're disappointed when they find out Stinker is searching for a lost fortune cookie from his Chinese takeout to learn his fate. Retracing the dog's steps, they chase the fortune cookie's trail through town.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has gone all out for his dinner guest, the she-bear. But just as he is about to kiss her… Vroom! In the middle of a mad car race, the Lemmings wake him up with a jolt! Dragged out of his slumber and swept away upon a vehicle, Grizzy finishes the race in a daze. Not far away, the Lemmings find a mask that can control dreams. Once Grizzy gathers his wits, he wants only to get hold of the object and return to the she-bear of his dreams. But the Lemmings have other dreams, like high-powered racing cars.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a documentary on salmon, whereas the Lemmings want to dance it up in the garage, nightclub style. TV versus music, the sonic war has begun! When a cloud passes overhead, Grizzy realizes that their respective gadgets run on electricity provided by solar panels. No more sun, no more electricity! He devises a plan whereby he will be the only one to access the energy, but the Lemmings have not said their last word!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A confrontation between Grizzy and the Lemmings leads to a room in the castle tower. The bear accidentally sets off a mechanism and discovers a large medieval magic trunk.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. But before the predators can strike, Uncle Jack and Pa swoop in, tackling the dinos with daring moves and perfect timing! As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Ma and Pa’s last day on Dino Island, and the Ranchers are determined to make it perfect! So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After (accidentally) rescuing a kitten from a tree Mr. Bean is set to have his picture in the newspaper! The photographer arrives with the grateful lady cat owner, the scene is set, smiles all round…but then disaster strikes when Bean is continually upstaged by… his hair.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Beaver has set himself the task of building the tallest tower possible. Unfortunately, it's dark before he can finish, but he's not going to stop, despite the difficulties of building in the dark. As for the Baby Lemmings, they're enjoying the spectacle of shooting stars when suddenly one of them crashes not far from them! A pretty, shiny, luminous stone. They decide to send it back up into the sky with the other stars. But Baby Beaver would love this luminous stone, which would enable him to continue his work even in the dark.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: After Nightbike reveals that he's afraid of loud noises, the Batwheels help him overcome his fear so he can stop The Penguin from strealing some valuable cargo.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped. Bean tracks down the nasty men responsible and finds that Teddy is not their only captive. Mr. Bean rescues a hundred teddy bears once their ears are put through an industrial sewing machine.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Shaggy drags the gang to an arcade where he's determined to finally collect enough tickets to win the prize he's wanted since he was a boy. Unfortunately, the animatronic mascot of the place has apparently come to life and has other ideas. / Fred comes face to face with his longstanding nemesis Captain Cutler who seems to have turned over new leaf as a restaurateur but is plagued by a ghostly pirate.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings shave ice from the icefield and whip it into granita, but the result is flavorless. He decides to make granita in an empty jar of Yummy so that the chocolate left over on the sides of the jar will flavor the dessert. It’s delicious! The Lemmings, who consider it was their recipe, swap the chocolate granita with another one made in an old flowerpot with potting soil. The choco-granito race is off and running!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are starving for their reserves are depleted and their fishing has been unsuccessful. Fortunately, a truck delivers a crate of edibles to the research station that contains compact food cubes. When placed under a special light beam, the cubes retransform into delicious meals. Grizzy discovers that the decompressing lamp can, conversely, compact organic elements too. For example, the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings pace around the log cabin searching for virtual animals to capture with their tablet game. Annoyed by their behavior, Grizzy throws them outside. Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV. But it doesn’t take the bear long to figure out that the U.V. cabin also has a DVD function.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to redecorate the hall, Bean is obstructed at every turn by his landlady’s vile one-eyed cat. Bean pops it in the dustbin to keep it out of the way for a while. Just his luck that it’s rubbish collection day.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bam must lead a new super vehicle team consisting of Nightbike, Goldie, Grundy, and Kitty after the Legion of Zoom traps the rest of the Batwheels in the Batcave.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bibi guides the audience through an interactive workout featuring jumping, spinning, and other athletic feats!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred is on trial, convicted of being the real mastermind behind all the mysteries he's solved. With the help of his defense attorney, Daphne, we go back over the day's events at a town that had been abandoned since the 1950's because of a toxic chemical spill where a Toxic Mutant has been terrorizing all who dare go near the town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs are so obsessed with catching Lamput that even in their dreams, the chase goes on. It’s really not a restful sleep, when you keep waking up sweating from horrid visions that, let’s face it, just remind you what a nightmare your day job is. The Docs make the brave decision to see a therapist about these terrible dreams. In the waiting room is the last orange blob they wanted to see; apparently a life of hot pursuit is taking its toll on Lamput, too. The shrink will have to resort to some very unconventional treatments.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are herding a massive pack of pachycephalosaurs! The stubborn herd keeps scattering in every direction! High above, Miguel spots danger ahead, a tiny psittacosaurus right in the herd’s path! Miguel swoops down and plucks the little dino out of harm’s way, but the pint-sized creature unleashes a squawk so loud it rattles the trees, sending the baby dino tumbling into the jungle below!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During an underwater patrol, the Ranchers spot Shelly, their young sea turtle friend. But Shelly urges the team to follow her into the depths, straight to a weakened Mama Turtle! Min quickly diagnoses the problem: shell shingles!t Uncle Jack delivers bad news, they’re short on Blue Sea Kelp, the only remedy! Jon and Miguel, ever the eager “bro-moms,” volunteer to go fetch it!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr Bean finally arrives but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire. Forced to borrow some clothes from the local launderette Bean is mistaken for the star of the show and ends up on the stage giving the operatic performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes a taxi to his local toyshop but a dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Mr Bean for a ride. After a mix up Mr Bean finds himself driving the taxi and starts to have fun couriering people to their destinations even giving an American tourist an extensive tour of London. But will the taxi driver find out what’s been going on and how much will Bean’s final fare be?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After a head-on collision with the milkman, Mr. Bean’s landlady is rushed to hospital, leaving him to look after her odious one-eyed cat Scrapper. Fur isn’t the only thing that flies and in the end it’s Bean that needs looking after.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: As the storm rages, Baby Owl's tree is struck by lightning! She's left without a nest. The Baby Lemmings seek shelter from the wind, and find refuge in a crumbling cave. They decide to decorate it in a makeover style. Unintentionally, they take the items Baby Owl had prepared for her new nest. She comes to get them back, but the Baby Lemmings don't understand why.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Today, Baby Raccoon has decided to iron all the tree leaves in the forest so that they lie flat, and pile them up in a neat heap. This new obsession allows the Baby Lemmings to discover the joys of origami. But there's a lot of failure in the Baby Lemmings' work, as they leave the crumpled leaves on the ground, unknowingly destroying Baby Raccoon's work.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose loves to frolic in fields of flowers! What he doesn't like, however, are the bees that gather pollen in them. Unlike Baby Lemmings, who have discovered that when you give them flowers, they make honey! Baby Moose is determined to “protect” the Baby Lemmings at all costs, and to keep them away from the hive they've found.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Wile E. Coyote attempts to show Bugs the future of yard maintenance with limited results.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bigfoot pops in for an unexpected visit and Bugs decides it's high time Bigfoot learned a few things regarding etiquette.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Yosemite escapes from jail only to discover he is woefully uninformed regarding banking in the twenty-first century. He ellicits Bugs' help who is more than happy to assist.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has misplaced his acorns beneath the pitcher's mound of a recently built baseball stadium. Bugs offers his assistance in retrieving them.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion. Meanwhile Fred believes you can't solve a mystery on Halloween. But all is explained when the gang runs into a witch and Fred reveals that he ran into the same witch 11 years ago with his cousin.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: On a trip to Japan to visit Velma's friend, the gang comes face to face with the ancient crab monster, Kaniaku, and attempts to solve a 700 year-old mystery. Meanwhile, Daphne accidentally becomes a viral media sensation in Japan!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After Tom drifts off to sleep, a tumbleweed blows into his face, and he discovers that the kitchen looks like an old west saloon. The bartender, Spike, and customers recognize him as the Catnip Kid. Then he sees himself in the mirror—dressed like a gunslinger, a silver-plated pea shooter holstered to his hip! Will Sherriff Jerry bring him to justice in this western adventure?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom blows on a trumpet to dislodge Jerry from his hiding place, which leads to Frankie the rat convincing Tom he's a great trumpeter. Frankie plays manager, Jerry joins in as percussionist, and they audition neighborhood animals for a third member of their jazz trio. Unfortunately, when Spike is chosen on the upright double bass, rivalries spark up and nerves threaten the trio's success.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Overweight Jerry starts working out on a weight machine supplied to him by cousin Muscles. Not to be outdone, Tom starts lifting weights as well – which sets up an epic Battle Royale between the cat and mouse.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the ranger's collection of bird calls by chance. With a simple blow of the whistle, he can attract a flock of partridges that are at his beck and call. For Grizzy, it's a super-practical way of being waited on by feathered servants, while the Lemmings see it as a golden opportunity to have a squadron which obeys at the drop of a dime.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While fighting over a jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings set off a chain reaction which sends the jar flying into space, where it damages the space station. Amongst the debris that falls in front of the cabin, the Lemmings discover a box that cancels out gravity.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a magician's hat that tosses out objects stored inside beforehand with the tap of a magic wand. He decides to impress his beloved she-bear with a magician's act. But he will have to work around the Lemmings, who have the gift of coming out of the hat at the wrong moment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to try out the brand new packaging format of chocolate spread that he discovers in the ranger's cupboard: a yummy-looking XXL jar. And he does not intend to share it with the Lemmings. After observing a chameleon toad that is able to blend into its surroundings, the Lemmings decide to make themselves invisible to attain Grizzy's treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A magic tomahawk divides Grizzy into two identical bears with diametrically opposite personalities: one short-tempered, the other super-sweet. The Lemmings, who did not witness Grizzy's split, will have a hard time working out the behavior of their usual enemy, who seems to swing from excessive kindness to the worst trickery for no reason.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After studying a magazine advertisement with a couple standing in front of an SUV, Grizzy imagines that if only he had a nice car, his favorite she-bear would be interested in him. He decides to confiscate the Lemmings crate on wheels and give it a serious overhaul. The Lemmings have nothing against an upgrade, as long as they remain behind the wheel!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids engage in an epic battle to take the Kazoom fragment, which ultimately activates the volcano.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: The Legion of Zoom is tired of always losing. They decide to take a page from the Batwheels and try using teamwork in order to pull off a daring heist. But will they be able to work together?

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Redbird sacrifices his stealth muffler tech to sound as loud as the other Batwheels - but his modifications backfire when Robin needs his stealthy skills to catch the elusive Catwoman!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Batcomputer shuts down for a system update, the other Batwheels must take over for her while aiding Batman in a battle against Harley Quinn.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: MOE wants to know what it's like to be a member of the Batwheels, but the bot gets more than he bargained for when Bam invites him along for an exciting mission to stop Poison Ivy.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Tweety leads The Looney Builders in building a new merry-go-round at the park for the kids. His crane breaks down and his small size affects his ability to contribute to the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders learn that Taz accidentally destroyed his house, so they set out to build him a new one that’s smash-proof.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Looney Builders build themselves a playground, Daffy gets so excited about his section that he takes all the supplies for himself.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac and Tosh Gopher to build them a home underground. Daffy can’t remove rocks from the area fast enough and fails to ask for help.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: An action-packed music video of The Looney Builders traveling across land, air, and sea to get the job done.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean attempts to build a shady gazebo in the back garden on a scorching hot day. But as he digs into the ground he unearths a huge unexploded bomb. Trying to make Mrs Wicket aware of the danger and save Scrapper and Teddy from being blown to smithereens takes courage nerve and a Bean styled homemade bomb disposal kit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to the theatre to see a performance by a celebrated hypnotist Dr Daze. Bean is super keen to come up on stage and be part of the show. But after being hypnotized Bean unknowingly leaves the theatre not realizing that he is still under the influence and certain trigger sounds have him doing silly things at unexpected and embarrassing moments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings encounter a white bear which has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice which is slowly melting. The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by crushing them with one of the ranger's heavy trunks, which he immediately clears out of the cabin, his enemies stuck to it like stickers. What he doesn't know, is that the trunk contains a multifunction drone, complete with joystick and virtual reality headset, which enables embedded piloting. Thanks to this cutting-edge technology, the Lemmings decide to regain control of the situation!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a strange pond in an American Indian grotto that has the power to rejuvenate anyone who dips in it. They spray a bit of the water of youth onto Grizzy and he instantly turns into a harmless cub they can easily rid themselves of. But the effects of the waters are only temporary.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Before taking a nap, Grizzy locks the food cupboard to prevent the Lemmings from getting into it. And to be sure they cannot force the lock, Grizzy throws all the house tools into the ravine. The Lemmings find a crate of mini building-blocks which enables them to build a hammer... and any other object they wish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings happen on a native American Indian burial place under the ranger's cabin. When they accidentally activate a magic disk representing the earth, they are sent back in time to the prehistoric era...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a phial containing a love potion: anyone who drinks it immediately falls in love with the first creature he sees. Grizzy already imagines himself becoming irresistible in the eyes of his beloved she-bear. But that is without taking into account the Lemmings... clumsiness, and their rodeo caribou drinking the magic potion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings notice that Grizzy moves away from the jar of chocolate spread whenever he chases the fly buzzing around him. But the insect can never hold out long enough for the Lemmings to swipe the jar before being knocked out. They decide to give the fly intensive sports training.

Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: You never can tell when inspiration’s gonna strike. Specs and Skinny are having a nice evening at the theatre, enjoying a magic show, when the perfect Lamput-catching strategy falls right in their lap! “The perfect strategy” is a magic necklace of invisibility. “Falling in their lap” is stealing it from the magician’s dressing room. Specs and Skinny waste no time tracking Lamput down and ruining a perfectly good picnic. As usual the Docs snatch defeat from the jaws of victory when Lamput gets a hold of the necklace. Now the orange blob can morph AND go invisible. No fair!

programme.title: Le Manas'66. Plento karaliai
programme.desc: Dviem Oskarais apdovanota, tikrais įvykiais paremta juosta apie lenktynes, pakeitusias „Ford“ markės automobilių istoriją. Prestižinėse „Le Mano“ lenktynėse karaliaujantis „Ferrari“ buvo nenugalimas. Tačiau tai įkvėpė „Ford“ vadovą Henrį Fordą II siekti sėkmės bet kokia kaina. Jis žengė rizikingą ir labai abejotiną sėkmę žadantį žingsnį. Į komandą pasikvietęs genialų ir talentingą lenktynininką Keną Mailsą (Christian Bale) ir išradingąjį inžinierių Kerolą Šelbį (Matt Damon) jis davė savo komandai tris mėnesius iki naujų lenktynių. Po alinančio darbo, įtampos ir bemiegių naktų, tai, kas atrodė neįmanoma, tapo realybe. Visiškai naujas „Ford GT40” nuvertė nuo sosto „Ferrari“ ir buvo nepralenkiamas trejus metus. „Ford GT40“ modelis tapo legenda ir geriausiai atpažįstamu automobilių pasaulio istorijoje.

programme.title: Ledynmetis 2. Eros pabaiga
programme.desc: Žemę dengiantis ledas pradeda tirpti, visiems priešistoriniams gyvūnams suteikdamas daug džiaugsmo. Dabar jie gali maudytis, šokinėti nuo tramplinų, grožėtis geizeriais ar turkštis natūraliose purvo voniose. Niekas net neįtaria, kad artėjantis potvynis gali sunaikinti visą slėnį. Laimei, apie tai pirmieji sužino mamutas Manfredas, tigras Diegas ir tinginys Sidas. Šaunioji trijulė ne tik privalo perspėti visus apie gresiantį pavojų, bet ir sugalvoti būdą, kaip pasprukti nuo artėjančio potvynio!

programme.title: Diena po rytojaus
programme.desc: Siaubingi uraganai siaubia Los Andželą. Nematyta pūga siaubingai užgriūna Indiją. Greipfrutų dydžio kruša bombarduoja Tokiją. Niujorke temperatūra per vieną dieną svyruoja nuo kaitros iki stingdančio speigo. Netikėti staigūs klimato pokyčiai visame pasaulyje sukelia neregėto masto kataklizmus – žemės drebėjimus, milžiniškas potvynių bangas. Profesorius Edrienas Holas tyrinėja klimato pokyčius, kuriuos sukėlė pragaištingas „šiltnamio reiškinys“. Be to, jis privalo surasti ir išgelbėti savo sūnų, kartu su draugais įkalintą milžinišku ledo miestu virtusiame Niujorke. Prasidėjus nevaldomam visuotiniam bėgimui, herojus iškeliauja ten, iš kur visi trokšta kuo greičiau ištrūkti – į bekraštes ledo ir sniego platybes, netikėtai nusidriekusias ten, kur dar neseniai stūksojo modernūs didmiesčiai...

programme.title: Išėjimo nėra
programme.desc: Reabilitacijos centre besigydanti Darbė trokšta tik vieno, - kuo greičiau pasprukti. Vos pasitaikius progai, jauna mergina pabėga nuo prižiūrėtojų ir vogtu automobiliu patraukia į gimtinę. Darbė skuba aplankyti sergančią motiną, bet užklupus pūgai keliai tampa nepravažiuojami. Nelieka nieko kito, kaip apsistoti atokioje kalnų poilsio aikštelės trobelėje ir laukti kol stichija nurims. Trobelėje Darbė susipažįsta su keturiais nelaimėliais, kurie dėl snygio taip pat buvo priversti nutraukti keliones. Matydama, kad su nepažįstamaisiais teks praleisti ne vieną valandą, mergina desperatiškai trokšta paskambinti mamai ir nuraminti ją, bet telefono signalas neveikia. Išėjusi į kiemą patikrinti mobiliojo ryšio stiprumo, Darbė netikėtai išgirsta keistus garsus. Viename iš aikštelėje stovinčių automobilių, mergina aptinka siaubo apimtą, pagrobtą vaiką. Dabar Darbė turi sukaupti visą drąsą ir sumanumą. Ji privalo išsiaiškinti, kuris iš nepažįstamųjų yra pagrobėjas. Ar išlaisvinusi mergaitę ji sugebės pasirūpinti jos saugumu? Galbūt name laukiantys žmonės yra susimokę ir visi stos prieš nekaltą vaiką ir Darbę?

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Briti parim noor pagar
programme.desc: Kuulsaima küpsetussaate variant noorte meistritega. 9 - 13aastased noored annavad endast kõik, et saada oma oskuste ja originaalsete retseptidega maa parimaks pagariks.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud
programme.desc: Lõbus ja hariv saade loomadest nii looduses kui koduaias. Igas osas saame teada huvitavaid ja üllatavaid tõsiasju ning mis kõige toredam, loomad ise räägivad endist...

programme.title: Joonistame koos
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstnik Will Sliney näitab, kuidas joonistada tegelasi maailma tuntumatest multikatest, nagu näiteks „Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks“, „Vali maja“, „Boss Beebi“, „Käpapatrull“ ja paljud teised.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Bahamos
programme.desc: Kelionė į pasakiškus Bahamus pritraukia spalvingą keliautojų kompaniją. Melanė ir jos vyras Filipas prieš dvidešimt metų čia susipažino ir pamilo vienas kitą. Bėda ta, kad Melanės prisiminimai apie jų pažintį yra migloti. Moteris po avarijos tris savaites buvo komos būsenoje. Ši kelionė netikėtai atskleidžia nemalonią tiesą, kuri kelia grėsmę ilgametei poros santuokai. Laivu plaukia ir psichoterapeutė Marija Vagner, kurią lydi jos sūnus Tomas. Tomas nekantrauja savo motiną supažindinti su naująja mergina Klara Miuler. Tačiau visai netrukus paaiškėja, kad Marija yra Klaros gydytoja ir ne kas kitas, o ji paskatino merginą pradėti rimtesnius santykius. Romanas Šmitas ir Sebastianas Prinzas - geriausi draugai, kartu kadaise investavę ir praradę visus pinigus. Laive jie pamato Maiką Kvastą – žmogų, kaltą dėl jų nelaimės. Ką draugai sugalvos, kad atgautų santaupas?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Inspektorius Mažylis
programme.desc: Populiarus aktorius M. Jampolskis premjeroje atlieka pagrindinį – nedidelio miestelio policijos inspektoriaus Andriaus Mažylio – vaidmenį. Filme policininką visur lydi jo tarnybinis vokiečių aviganis, vardu Mažylis. Su šunimi į gimtąjį miestelį grįžęs dirbti Andrius po keleto metų, praleistų policijos akademijoje, randa labai pasikeitusią aplinką: dabar čia viską valdo nusikaltėliai ir korumpuoti vietos valdininkai. A. Mažyliui su bendravardžiu šunimi teks gerokai paplušėti, kad gimtinėje vėl viešpatautų tvarka ir ramybė. Filmo kūrėjai sako, kad šiame detektyve netrūks ir meilės istorijų, o siužetas bus įdomus visai šeimai: „Inspektoriaus Mažylio“ nuotykiai pasakojami su ironijos gaidele, humoristiniais pasisakymais, su šypsena žvelgiant į šviesiąsias gyvenimo puses.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Jei savo virtuvėje jaučiatės labiau svečiais nei šeimininkais, jums į pagalbą atskubės Kotryna Starkienė! Šį sezoną įvairius sezoninius patiekalus iš savo pačios užsiaugintų gėrybių ji ruoš ne tik žiūrovams jau pažįstamoje sodyboje, bet pakvies apsilankyti ir didmiesčio virtuvėje. Čia žiūrovų lauks gardūs, tačiau tuo pat metu ir lengvi, laiką taupyti padedantys receptai. Žiūrovų laukia patarimai, kaip pasiruošti maisto visai savaitei, ką įdėti vaikams į priešpiečių dėžutes ar kaip greitai ir nebrangiai paruošti patiekalus draugų vakarienei.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Vankuveris
programme.desc: Šioje kelionėje daug darbo tenka laivo gydytojai Džesikai Delgado. Net keli keleiviai reikalauja ypatingos medicininės priežiūros.Korina Sandler serga išsėtine skleroze ir desperatiškai trokšta rasti atsakymus į jai ramybės neduodančius klausimus. Drauge su sužadėtiniu Tariku Steinu, ji leidžiasi į Kanados miškus ieškoti žmogaus, parašiusio knygą apie šią klastingą ligą. Mergina tiki, kad susitikimas suteiks informacijos, kaip toliau gyventi turint tokią diagnozę. Gerus ketinimus nutraukia dar vienas ligos paūmėjimas. Po žmonos mirties nutrūksta Rainerio Chromo santykiai su paaugliu sūnumi Niklasu. Tėvo ir sūnaus kelionė skirta suartėjimui. Bet viskas pasikeičia, kai Vankuveryje Raineris pamato savo sūnų tarp drag queenų. Jo siaubui Niklas vilki suknelę. Ar Raineris sugebės priimti naują sūnaus pusę?Laivo personalui vadovaujantis Martinas Grimms iš laivybos kompanijos gauna pasiūlymą tapti kito laivo kapitonu. Martinas nori šį pasiūlymą aptarti su kapitonu Pargeriu, bet jų išvyka baigiasi netikėtai. Vyrai priversti praleisti naktį Kanados gamtoje. Tarp jų kyla ginčas ir dabar jau nėra aišku, ką nuspręs Martinas Grimas dėl savo ateities.

Filmo kūrėjai sako, kad šiame detektyve netrūks ir meilės istorijų, o siužetas bus įdomus visai šeimai: „Inspektoriaus Mažylio“ nuotykiai pasakojami su ironijos gaidele, humoristiniais pasisakymais, su šypsena žvelgiant į šviesiąsias gyvenimo puses.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
